notes.command.scope: Informational label only — it appears inside `cmd` and has NO execution effect; command verifiers always run at the repository root. `cwd` was removed: executing at a spec-chosen directory is unimplemented attack surface with no consumer.
notes.command.timeoutMs: Optional execution budget in milliseconds; defaults to 120000 when absent. Unlike `scope` this DOES have an execution effect — it is passed to the executor. A criterion whose command legitimately runs longer than the default must declare one, or it fails intermittently with no exit code (a signalled death, not a non-zero exit). Measured on the reference machine: the governance suite takes ~105s against the 120s default, a 14% margin.
